notes: El puente de Ethereum a Kadena ensena el gas en dolares y si esta caro o barato; el DCA avisa mientras se fija el precio limite. / The Ethereum to Kadena bridge shows gas in dollars and whether it is expensive or cheap; DCA tells you while the price limit is being set.

notes_i18n.es:
GAS DE ETHEREUM EN EL PUENTE

- Al simular un envio de Ethereum a Kadena, debajo del resultado sale lo que costara el gas: en ETH y en dolares, con el precio del gas del momento.
- Dice si son una o dos ordenes (autorizar el token y enviar) y da el total de las dos.
- Va en color: rojo si el gas esta caro, ambar si esta normal y verde si esta barato, comparado con las ultimas 3 horas. Al lado, lo que costaria a precio normal.
- Es el precio de ese instante: al ejecutar de verdad se paga el gas que haya en ese momento. Si esta caro, espera y vuelve a simular.

DCA

- Al crear un plan con precio limite, la fila del plan dice «Poniendo el precio limite...» hasta que la cadena lo tiene. Antes decia «Sin precio limite» durante ese rato y parecia que no se habia guardado.
notes_i18n.en:
ETHEREUM GAS ON THE BRIDGE

- When you simulate a transfer from Ethereum to Kadena, the gas cost appears under the result: in ETH and in dollars, at the current gas price.
- It says whether it takes one or two transactions (approve the token and send) and gives the total for both.
- It is colour coded: red when gas is expensive, amber when normal and green when cheap, compared with the last 3 hours. Next to it, what it would cost at the usual price.
- It is the price at that moment: the real send pays whatever gas costs then. If it is expensive, wait and simulate again.

DCA

- When you create a plan with a price limit, the plan row says "Setting the price limit..." until the chain has it. It used to say "No price limit" during that time, which looked as if it had not been saved.
